'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: Critical. `resolve-ztoken` DEPENDS ON A CACHE THE CALLER CAN SHAPE. It reads `lindex` from `get-cached-indexes` - the market's own `index-cache`, not the vault - and multiplies the underlying price by it before dividing by `INDEX-PRECISION`. Establish, for every entry point, whether that cache entry was primed from a genuinely accrued vault state, from a state the same transaction has already mutated, or not at all. Show a rehypothecated collateral valuation derived from an index that does not reflect the vault at the moment of the health check. Impact: protocol insolvency.'
